parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the application on which you want to grant permissions.

parameters.name: OrganizationalUnitIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the organizations to which you want to grant permissions. You can grant permissions to a maximum of 100 organizations at a time.
